service.description: Register a new user with email and password using Moqui's UserAccount for authentication. Creates UserAccount first, then NovelAnimeUser with 500 initial credits, and returns JWT token on success. Requirements: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 2.1

parameter.name: email
parameter.description: User email address (must be valid format and unique)

parameter.name: username
parameter.description: Optional display name for the user

service.description: Authenticate user with username/email and password using Moqui's built-in authentication. Auto-creates NovelAnimeUser record if not exists, generates JWT token, and updates lastLoginDate. Requirements: 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4

parameter.name: username
parameter.description: Username or email address for login

service.description: Verify JWT signature and expiration. Returns combined user info from UserAccount and NovelAnimeUser. Requirements: 2.3, 2.4

parameter.name: token
parameter.description: JWT access token (optional - will be extracted from Authorization header if not provided)

service.description: Invalidate token by adding to blacklist. Clears user session. Requirements: 6.1

parameter.name: token
parameter.description: JWT access token to invalidate (optional - will be extracted from Authorization header if not provided)

service.description: Get user profile by joining UserAccount and NovelAnimeUser data. Returns combined user information including username, email from UserAccount and credits, avatarUrl, status from NovelAnimeUser. Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6

parameter.name: userId
parameter.description: User ID (optional - will be extracted from JWT token if not provided)

parameter.name: token
parameter.description: JWT access token (optional - will be extracted from Authorization header if not provided)

service.description: Refresh access token using refresh token
Generate GitHub OAuth authorization URL for initiating login flow. Requirements: 2.1.1

parameter.name: redirectUri
parameter.description: Optional custom redirect URI after OAuth completion

service.description: Exchange GitHub authorization code for access token and authenticate user. Creates new user with 500 credits if first login, or links to existing account. Requirements: 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.1.4

parameter.name: code
parameter.description: Authorization code from GitHub OAuth callback

service.description: Handle GitHub OAuth callback redirect. Exchanges code for token and returns user data. Requirements: 2.1.1, 2.1.2
Check if GitHub user already exists, create UserAccount first, then link NovelAnimeUser. Returns unified profile response same as regular login. Requirements: 5.1, 5.2, 5.3

parameter.name: githubAccessToken
parameter.description: GitHub access token for API calls

service.description: Generate Google OAuth authorization URL for initiating login flow. Requirements: 2.2.1

parameter.name: redirectUri
parameter.description: Optional custom redirect URI after OAuth completion

service.description: Exchange Google authorization code for access token and authenticate user. Creates new user with 500 credits if first login, or links to existing account. Requirements: 2.2.1, 2.2.2

parameter.name: code
parameter.description: Authorization code from Google OAuth callback

service.description: Handle Google OAuth callback redirect. Exchanges code for token and returns user data. Requirements: 2.2.1, 2.2.2
Check if Google user already exists, create UserAccount first, then link NovelAnimeUser. Returns unified profile response same as regular login. Requirements: 5.1, 5.2, 5.3

parameter.name: googleAccessToken
parameter.description: Google access token for API calls

service.description: Generate WeChat login QR code URL and return ticket for status polling. Requirements: 2.3.1

parameter.name: redirectUri
parameter.description: Optional custom redirect URI after OAuth completion

service.description: Check scan status by ticket. Returns status: waiting/scanned/confirmed/expired. Requirements: 2.3.1, 2.3.3

parameter.name: ticket
parameter.description: QR code ticket for status checking

service.description: Exchange WeChat authorization code for access token and authenticate user. Creates new user with 500 credits if first login, or links to existing account. Requirements: 2.3.2, 2.3.4

parameter.name: code
parameter.description: Authorization code from WeChat OAuth callback

service.description: Handle WeChat OAuth callback redirect. Exchanges code for token and returns user data. Requirements: 2.3.1, 2.3.2
Check if WeChat user already exists, create UserAccount first, then link NovelAnimeUser. Returns unified profile response same as regular login. Requirements: 5.1, 5.2, 5.3

parameter.description: WeChat access token for API calls

service.description: Update user profile information. Updates UserAccount.userFullName if fullName provided. Updates NovelAnimeUser.avatarUrl if avatarUrl provided. Returns updated combined user profile. Requirements: 6.1, 6.2, 6.3, 6.4

parameter.name: userId
parameter.description: User ID (optional - will be extracted from JWT token if not provided)

parameter.name: fullName
parameter.description: New display name for the user

parameter.name: avatarUrl
parameter.description: New avatar URL for the user

service.description: Change user password securely. Verifies current password first, then updates with new password. Requirements: 7.1, 7.2, 7.3, 7.4

parameter.name: userId
parameter.description: User ID (optional - will be extracted from JWT token if not provided)

service.description: Upload user avatar image. Accepts base64 encoded image data, saves to dbresource, and updates NovelAnimeUser.avatarUrl. Returns the URL of the uploaded avatar.

parameter.name: userId
parameter.description: User ID (optional - will be extracted from JWT token if not provided)

parameter.name: imageData
parameter.description: Base64 encoded image data (with or without data URI prefix)

parameter.name: filename
parameter.description: Original filename (optional, used for extension detection)
